title: Randomized success guarantee
contract: Two independent uniform bits give probability 3/4 of at least one success; exact probability under stated sample distribution.
scope: Four equiprobable pairs if independent; correlated distribution repeats (0,0),(1,1); admission independence.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Success mass equals 3 of 4 equally weighted outcomes.

variants.description: Compute success by testing that pair is not (0,0).
